lessons.title: Variables and console.log
lessons.summary: Store values and print them out.
lessons.explanation: JavaScript variables hold values you want to reuse. Use 'let' for values that change, 'const' for ones that don't. console.log() prints to the developer console — useful for checking what your code is doing.
keyPoints: 'let' for values that can be reassigned
